payload.title: Antigravity and Cursor readers find no sessions on current installs
payload.description: Real installs (2026-11-01, macOS) show 0 sessions: (1) Antigravity conversation_summaries.db now has table conversation_summaries(conversation_id,title,last_modified_time,parent_conversation_id,nesting_depth,battle_id,...), not conversations(id,name,updated_at); payload.db is gone. (2) Cursor CLI transcripts moved to agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl with sub-agents at agent-transcripts/<uuid>/subagents/<uuid>.jsonl; records are {role,message} with no timestamps. (3) Cursor IDE store default on macOS is ~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb, not ~/.cursor/state.vscdb; the Cursor CLI source is also missing from 'botspy sources'.
